name: Ingest Router
summary: One storage trigger per bucket, dispatched by file type. Centralizes etag idempotency, HEAD-verify, and loop safety.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_ENDPOINT
env.description: S3-compatible Object Storage endpoint. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: Object Storage access key. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: Object Storage secret key. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: ROUTER_BUCKET
env.description: Bucket this router watches. Storage triggers watch exactly one bucket each.

env.name: ROUTER_PREFIX
env.description: Watched key prefix. Must be disjoint from any output prefix, since there is no negative prefix filter.

env.name: ROUTER_OUTPUT_BUCKET
env.description: Where downstream blocks write derivatives. Defaults to a separate bucket, because writing into the watched bucket retriggers the router forever.

env.name: ROUTER_OUTPUT_PREFIX
env.description: Prefix for derivatives when sharing the input bucket. Startup fails unless it is provably disjoint from ROUTER_PREFIX.

env.name: ROUTER_ROUTES
env.description: JSON mapping file kind to job types, e.g. {"image":["vision.tag"],"pdf":["rag.ingest"]}. Kinds with no route are recorded as unrouted rather than dropped.

env.name: ROUTER_MAX_BYTES
env.description: Objects larger than this are recorded and skipped rather than dispatched.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating trigger delivery. Strongly recommended.

triggers.description: The single trigger for the bucket. Dispatches in-function by detected file kind.
Required by §5. Re-dispatches objects the trigger never delivered.
